messages.subject: init printing errors in CmdStan?
parts:
Does anyone know if we fixed the issue with not printing
error messages arising in inits? It came up with a user
model (Jan Glaescher's) being discussed on stan-users, which
is really confusing me.

Daniel or Rob --- if you have time to try to help with this
one, it'd be great. I wouldn't be so worried if the error
messages weren't so confusing --- this looks like some kind
of issue where we'll need to update Stan to provide better
error messages.

- Bob
